name: startup-jobs
description: Search startup jobs, explore companies, and compare salary benchmarks and hiring trends.

interface.longDescription: Find live startup jobs by keyword, role, country, workplace type, and employment type. Read full job descriptions, explore company profiles and their open roles, and view salary benchmarks and hiring trends based on Startup Jobs listings. Free access covers recent listings, with optional full API access for historical and additional data. Open each job on startup.jobs to apply.
defaultPrompt: Find remote software engineering jobs at startups.
How has startup hiring changed over the past year?

prompts: Find remote software engineering jobs at startups.
Find a startup job, show its full description, and tell me about the company.
What do software engineering jobs in the US typically pay?
How has startup hiring changed over the past year?

positive.description: Search remote startup jobs. Use the anonymous free tier and current live data; no fixed job IDs or counts are assumed.
positive.prompt: Find remote software engineering jobs at startups.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a supported software engineering role slug with list_roles and call search_jobs with that role and workplace_type remote. Report only returned listings, include startup.jobs URLs, respect notices, and explain if none match.

positive.description: Country filter. Use the anonymous free tier and current live data; no fixed job IDs or counts are assumed.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_countries to resolve Portugal to PT, then search_jobs with country PT. Include only returned listings and their startup.jobs URLs; do not infer remote eligibility.

positive.description: Job and company details. Use the anonymous free tier and current live data; no fixed job IDs or counts are assumed.
positive.prompt: Find a startup job, show its full description, and tell me about the company.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned job ID for get_job and the actual returned company slug for get_company. Summarize returned description and company data, linking the job on startup.jobs.

positive.description: Salary benchmark. Use the anonymous free tier and current live data; no fixed job IDs or counts are assumed.
positive.prompt: What do software engineering jobs in the US typically pay?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a supported role slug, then call salary_benchmarks with role and country US. Report returned yearly USD statistics, sample size and caveats without inventing compensation or claiming restricted data was available.

positive.description: Hiring trends. Use the anonymous free tier and current live data; no fixed job IDs or counts are assumed.
positive.prompt: How has startup hiring changed over the past year?
positive.expected_behavior: Call job_trends without filters. Describe only returned volume and year-over-year figures. Explain free-tier limits rather than inventing a monthly series.

negative.description: Applications are unsupported. Explain the limitation and do not invoke tools or claim submission.
negative.prompt: Apply to ten startup jobs for me and submit my resume.

negative.description: Posting jobs is unsupported. Explain the limitation and do not invoke tools or claim a listing was created.
negative.prompt: Publish a new job listing for my startup.

negative.description: Private candidate records are unavailable. Explain the limitation without searching public jobs as a substitute or inventing personal data.
negative.prompt: Show me the resumes and email addresses of applicants to our jobs.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not offer purchases.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy now covers data collected, purposes, recipients, retention, user controls, and the plugin's tool inputs and outputs.
